design: Short heavy adult guard with blue-grey pebble-textured hide and a broad dome biomask worn on face: deep rounded brow plate, long central nose ridge, two broad cheek guards and open lower section showing tusks and mandibles. Thick dreadlocks fall only to chest. Bulky padded dark brown undercoat with broad bronze horizontal armor strips, large single battered shoulder plate, numerous squared belt pouches, ankle wraps. A short plain hammer-baton held downward alongside right thigh; left hand relaxed. Rounded low center-of-gravity silhouette.
